props.name: DateRangePickerProps
rows: Specifies the placeholder text that is rendered when the value is empty.
Specifies that the component is disabled, preventing the user from modifying the value. A disabled component cannot receive focus.
Specifies that the component is read-only, preventing the user from modifying the value. A read-only component can receive focus.
Fired when keyboard focus is set onto the UI control.
Fired when keyboard focus is removed from the UI control.
A function that defines whether a particular range is valid or not. Ensure that your function checks for missing fields in the value.
Specifies whether the component should show a button that allows the user to clear the selected value.
Specifies an additional control displayed in the dropdown, located below the range calendar.
Specifies which time units to allow in the custom relative range control.
Specifies custom content to fully override the relative range tab. When provided, all default relative range functionality is replaced.

Specifies the time format to use for displaying the absolute time range. It can take the following values: * `iso`: ISO 8601 format, e.g.: 2024-01-30T13:32:32+01:00 (or 2024-01-30 when `dateOnly` is true) * `long-localized`: a more human-readable, localized format, e.g.: January 30, 2024, 13:32:32 (UTC+1) (or January 30, 2024 when `dateOnly` is true) * `slashed`: similar to ISO 8601 but with '/' in place of '-'. e.g.: 2024/01/30 (or 2024/01)
Specifies whether to hide the time offset in the displayed absolute time range. Defaults to `false`.
Adds `aria-label` to the trigger and dropdown.

Specifies whether to start with the previous or current period (month or year) when multiple calendar grids are displayed in absolute mode. Defaults to 'auto', which starts with previous if no date is selected, or current if a selection is present.
Specifies custom content to fully override the trigger content. When provided, the default content of the trigger is replaced.
